_comment: Failure weight distribution for the synthetic QC corpus generator.
_grounding: Based on documented Netflix IMF submission patterns and Photon error taxonomy harvest.
_schema: Each entry: error_code → weight (relative probability when this category is selected).

category_weights._comment: Top-level category probabilities. Must sum to 1.0.

structural._comment: CPL errors are the dominant automated failure — most common single code.

audio._comment: Loudness compliance dominates audio failures (~60% of audio errors).

vendor_weakness_bias._comment: When a vendor's weakness category is sampled, probability that the error code comes from that category (vs the general distribution).

redelivery_attempt_distribution._comment: P(attempt count = n) for a failing title's redelivery chain. Weighted toward early resolution.

remediation_cost_usd._comment: Per-failure remediation cost range. Escalates with redelivery attempt number (factor: 1.5x per attempt).

pass_rate_by_attempt._comment: Cumulative fail rate multiplier per attempt: fail_rate * 0.7^attempt. Models vendor learning/improvement.
